description: Governor's Offiice - North Central - Appointment made by Hon.Governer of North Central Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists appointments of named individuals to specific government posts (e.g., Director of Sport, Chief Secretary, Secretary of the Ministry of Agriculture). It provides the names of the appointees and their basic job titles but does **not** include detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities, subject areas, or functions. According to the classification rules, this fits the definition of a **People Gazette (Type 2)**, which covers government personnel changes with basic titles only.
